# Data dictionary

`country` — printed country label; text.

`intercept` — reported regression intercept; numeric, Table1 does not state coefficient units; retain without conversion.

`fdi_slope` — reported coefficient for FDI inflow; numeric, Table1 does not state coefficient units; retain without conversion.

`r_squared` — reported R-squared; numeric proportion as printed.

`adjusted_r_squared` — reported adjusted R-squared; numeric proportion as printed.

`correlation_r` — reported correlation coefficient `r`; numeric.

`p_value` — reported p-value; numeric.

`f_test` — reported F-test statistic; numeric.

No missing values are added or imputed. The file contains six published country rows only; it does not contain individual observations.
